description: Reference mock data for 10 canonical test scenarios. Raw responses recorded live from hackathon.api.qloo.com (2026-10-14); expected envelopes generated through the real clients — pinned by server/test/referenceFixtures.test.js. Regenerate: node server/tests/fixtures/generate.mjs

scenarios.title: Film domain: search a TV show by name
scenarios.notes: search /search; raw tags use the tag_id shape of the live host

scenarios.title: Music domain: search an artist
scenarios.notes: music resolves to urn:entity:artist; live tag families for artists

scenarios.title: Dining domain: search a restaurant (place + restaurant tags)
scenarios.notes: dining resolves to urn:entity:place; restaurant tag families qualify it

scenarios.title: Fashion domain: search a brand (brand + fashion tags)
scenarios.notes: fashion resolves to urn:entity:brand; genre:brand:fashion family qualifies it

scenarios.title: Taste vector tags for an entity, scoped by tag type
scenarios.notes: /v2/tags live shape: results.tags with parents, popularity, nested tags

scenarios.title: Cross-domain affinity: artist signal -> movies, with attribution
scenarios.notes: /v2/insights live shape: query.affinity per entity, explainability under signal.interests.entities, root-level warning

scenarios.title: Audience insights: demographic signal -> places
scenarios.notes: demographic-only signal: live host computes no attribution, so explain/aggregate are null

scenarios.title: Audience discovery by keyword (URN lookup)
scenarios.notes: /v2/audiences live shape: results.audiences with parents and disambiguation

scenarios.title: Upstream 429 quota error surfaces as QlooApiError
scenarios.notes: live 429 body shape {"error_msg": ...}; QLOO_MAX_RETRIES=0 -> single attempt
